source: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask (2000), Nintendo EAD
framing: A parallel land, not Hyrule. The Skull Kid, wearing a stolen mask older than his mischief, holds Termina between three days and the falling moon. Link, riding Epona from the Lost Woods, has 72 hours — unless he wears the ocarina and the clock's own song.

days.name: The First Day
days.events: Link arrives in Clock Town; the carnival readies; the Bombers' secret signal; the Deku curse in the swamp.

days.name: The Second Day
days.events: The swamp's poison deepens; Snowhead's blizzard chokes the mountain; the sea off Great Bay grows wild; the stones of Ikana hum.

days.name: The Third Day
days.events: The moon hangs low and watching; the four giants are summoned by the Oath to Order; the door in the moon stands open.

cycle.law: Play the Song of Time and the day turns back; the ocarina is the only true authority in Termina.
cycle.moon_fall: On the third midnight the moon falls, and everything the land was is taken back.

regions.name: Clock Town
regions.lore: The carnival city at Termina's center — where the Bombers run, the bank guards your rupees, and everyone is too busy celebrating to see the sky.

regions.name: Woodfall / Southern Swamp
regions.lore: The poisoned swamp of the Deku — the Princess of the Deku turned to wood, the Monkey accused, the temple choked under Woodfall's crown.

regions.name: Snowhead / Mountain Village
regions.lore: The frozen mountain of the Gorons — a blizzard that is the grief of Goht, and the elder who froze himself to watch his people starve.

regions.name: Great Bay / Zora Hall
regions.lore: The sea of the Zora — the guitarist Lulu, whose voice the tribe stole; the lab of the scientist; the temple beneath the waves.

regions.name: Ikana Canyon
regions.lore: The kingdom of the dead — the Ancient Castle of Ikana, the Poe Collector's prizes, the Stone Tower that reaches past the sky, and the Stray Fairies in the well.

regions.name: The Moon
regions.lore: At the heart of the falling moon: a field of children, a chamber of trials, and the mask that wears its own wearer's face.
